title: merchant.suspended.v1
description: A merchant was suspended and may no longer create new payments. Published by the Merchant Registry (BC-2) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. The data plane cache treats this as a PRIORITY INVALIDATION: a suspended merchant that keeps processing because a cache was 30 seconds stale is a compliance finding, so this event jumps the ordinary refresh cadence.

reasonCode.description: Why the merchant was suspended. Drives operator routing and the merchant-facing message.

reasonDetail.description: Free-text detail for operators. Never contains personal data or secrets.

suspendedBy.description: Actor: a human identifier, or system:<component> when the automation plane suspended the merchant on a risk or compliance trigger.

effectiveAt.description: When the suspension takes effect. May be in the future for a scheduled suspension, which is why it is distinct from the envelope `time`.

permitsRefunds.description: Always true. Suspension rejects NEW payments but permits refunds, voids and webhook processing - you must always be able to give money back. Carried explicitly so no consumer has to remember the rule or infer it from a state name.
